messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy window starting for rollout r-2026-03-20-0312 to prod (subset=20%). preflight checks OK. tagging: @eng-oncall @eng-releases :rocket:
Elena: quick note — traffic shift starts at :03:15 UTC, observability hooks enabled. I'll watch the SLO dashboard.
Rajan: ack. I pushed the canary config, healthchecks passed on eu-west.
Maya: copying the checklist here:
```
# preflight quick checks
- kvcache: green
- p95 latency baseline < 150ms
- 5xx rate < 0.3% last 10m
- tracing sampling enabled
```
Siva: seeing small p95 bump in embed-route in eu-west at +1m, p95 -> 185ms (baseline 140). no errors.
Elena: thanks. keep an eye for error rate or steady p95. ops-bot, can you run the snapshot and attach?
ops-bot: snapshot done: https://internal.redwood/obs/snapshots/r-2026-03-20-0312/1 :white_check_mark:
Alicia: eyeballing logs — a backend pod restarted once, reason OOMKilled at 03:16:42. stack trace excerpt: `runtime: goroutine stack exceeds 1000000 bytes`
Rajan: OOM? odd, canary uses same instance size as baseline. rolling limit on batch size?
Maya: rolling limit tweak was in config but should be gated. I'm pausing further traffic at 20% until we confirm.
Elena: agreed. pause traffic and pin to v2.4.1 for this rollout. set fallback to v2.3.9.
Rajan: executing pin now: `deployctl pin --rollout r-2026-03-20-0312 --version v2.4.1 --traffic 20% --hold`
Rajan: command returned ok. traffic frozen at 20%.
Siva: after pin, error rate crept to 0.55% on embed-route (threshold 0.5%). spike coincides with the pod OOM.
Alicia: logs show repeated batch allocations from client batcher. suspect mis-specified client header leading to oversized batches.
Elena: decision required: do we rollback to v2.3.9 or reduce memory footprint and continue?
Maya: my recommendation is rollback to v2.3.9 for final 40% ramp; leave canary for investigation. rollback path is small and reversible.
Rajan: +1. rollback command ready: `deployctl rollback --rollout r-2026-03-20-0312 --to v2.3.9 --confirm`
Elena: do it. ops-bot, trigger rollback and notify oncall.
ops-bot: initiating rollback now. ETA ~90s. posting updates to thread.
(30s) ops-bot: rollback progress: 25% -> 75% -> complete. all traffic now on v2.3.9.
Siva: post-rollback metrics: p95 back to 138ms, 5xx rate 0.18%. good.
Elena: recorded rollback reason in release notes: "Canary OOM on embed-route due to unexpected batch size; rolled back to v2.3.9. Follow-up: adjust client batching and add mem limits."
Maya: opening follow-up ticket: RED-2345 "Investigate canary OOM and add guardrails". assigned to Rajan + Siva.
Rajan: I'll add an autoscaling guard and max-batch-size circuit in the client.
Elena: thanks team. postmortem doc pinned to the release channel once we have repro. I'll also schedule a short blameless huddle tomorrow 09:30 PST. :calendar:
Alicia: adding a note — consider adding a runtime memory probe to the canary job to fail fast rather than OOM.
Elena: agreed. closing the roll for now. deploy-bot: record event status=rolled_back, reason=oom-spike-batcher
deploy-bot: Event recorded.
Maya: action items captured in RED-2345, will update status after investigation.
Elena: thanks everyone. short debrief in #eng-releases in 30m. :thumbsup:
